provenance.title: Portrait of Natsume Soseki (夏目漱石), photographed September/October 1912

provenance.licenceBasis: Commons file categorized PD-Japan and PD-scan (PD-Japan); NDL Digital Collections item is marked internet-public (protection-period-expired). provenance.title: Front cover, first edition of『三四郎』(Sanshiro), Shunyodo, May 1909 (Meiji 42)
provenance.collection: National Diet Library Digital Collections (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/886555), mirrored to Wikimedia Commons as File:NDL886555 三四郎 part1.pdf
provenance.licenceBasis: Commons file categorized PD-Japan and PD-scan (PD-Japan), extmetadata License=pd. Cross-checked against the NDL bibliographic record (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/886555: 著者：夏目漱石 著, 出版者：春陽堂, 出版年月日：明42.5 -- Shunyodo, Meiji 42 = May 1909), matching the documented first-book-edition date. Design attribution to Hashiguchi Goyo (橋口五葉, d. 1921) is the commonly cited designer for Soseki's Shunyodo bindings of this period but is not independently confirmed on the Commons/NDL file page itself -- flagged as unconfirmed attribution, not asserted as fact.

provenance.title: Front cover, first edition of『鶉籠』(Uzura Kago), Shunyodo, January 1907 (Meiji 40) -- the collection volume containing the first book publication of『坊っちゃん』(Botchan)
provenance.collection: National Diet Library Digital Collections (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/885509), mirrored to Wikimedia Commons as File:NDL885509 鶉籠 part1.pdf
provenance.licenceBasis: Commons file categorized PD-Japan and PD-scan (PD-Japan), extmetadata License=pd. Cross-checked against the NDL bibliographic record (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/885509: 著者：夏目漱石（金之助）著, 出版者：春陽堂, 出版年月日：明40.1 -- Shunyodo, Meiji 40 = January 1907), matching Botchan's documented first-book-edition date (serialized in Hototogisu in 1906, then collected into this Shunyodo anthology on 1 January 1907). Note: Botchan itself was not published as a freestanding first-edition volume -- its first book appearance is inside this multi-work Uzura Kago collection (with 'I Am a Cat' excerpts and other short works), so this cover represents Botchan's true first-edition binding rather than a substitute.
